forecast_by_corpus.basis: Embedding at 10.74 per second, or by characters for main code's shorter chunks, at the pilot's 96.5 percent embedding share. Documents are scaled by their length and are not measured: at 2,292 characters a chunk they are the slowest part. A forecast, not a measurement.

unchanged_reconcile.basis: first read plus second read and hash, measured on this tree; catalogue calls to the route are additional
unchanged_reconcile.consequence: a launch on a tree this size spends minutes in the background confirming nothing changed. It parses every file to count coverage, which is what to change if this proves too slow.

correction_to_the_plan: P2's 89-100 items per second came from short synthetic text. Real chunks embed at about 9 to 11 per second on the same two threads, so the plan's 6-12 minute illustration becomes hours.
finding_from_the_sample: On Windows with long paths off, the file policy's walk silently missed 3,713 of Hadoop's 15,586 tracked files, including 3,592 Java files. It now reaches them; see ADR-037.
